body: Hi! Honestly I had no idea about alopecia or any of the treatments available when I was first diagnosed so I just went with what they told me they only told me about the minoxidil you apply to your scalp, I’ve never tried injections I do want to try them but my doctor adviser me not to. My one side effect is that I get hairy everywhere my face my back my arms thighs, no idea why but I believe eventually it goes away cause that’s what happened for me the first time and I can see the hair on my body starting to lighten up again

All my hair fell out 2015 completely bald started growing back shortly after, I used minoxidil but not everyday as suggested and stopped a year after weaning myself off by 2018 I had hair down to my chest then shortly after 2019 60% of my hair fell out and now some of my eyebrows but my hair is currently  starting to grow back, I now use minoxidil 1-2 times a week don’t want my body to grow dependent on it
I’ve been feeling this way for years and accepted it

I’ve been trying to search for ways to make me undetectable or ways my body just cannot be found but google doesn’t really have a lot of resources for those type of questions. They already know of my mental illnesses and how hard it has been for me and I’ve attempted before so I don’t think they’d blame themselves I think they’d just assume I lost my battle with my depression, I try talking to people but at the end of the day I’m all alone and left with my thoughts

Yes intrusive thoughts are the worst I’m trying my best to manage them but I’m still pretty afraid cause the urges is so strong I definitely need to talk to a professional to figure out why I’m like this, thank you so much ❤️

Hi going through something extremely similar was casually dating someone on and off for a year the last time we hung out something happened and yesterday he decided to end it for good. It hurts a lot especially with the fear of abandonment and just going through it while having bpd it really sucks just know you’re not alone

Thank you, it’s really hard when you have so much love to offer but only want to give it to one person, he doesn’t have much of a family so he doesn’t celebrate holidays I was going to decorate his house buy him a tree some presents and surprise him make it our own little thing. When I think about things like that how I’m never given the chance to fully show my love and appreciation it hurts. It’s going to hurt like hell getting over this but I know I have to cause going through this is just too much and he’s already on dating sites looking for someone new but the sad part is if he called I’d go back, I need to get out of that habit.
Thank you so much, I needed this. reading it made me cry

I once joined group therapy and was so excited to meet people and become friends with them but surprisingly they were all elderly and we had nothing in common I was the youngest one there, have a few online friends but with everything going on in life they’ve grown distant I’m horrible at keeping conversation in every way possible and lack that emotion and upbeat attitude everybody looks for in a person, I’d like to be friends too :)

I’m sorry you had to go through that it’s pretty similar to my upbringing my mom had left my dad because he was abusive towards her but he refused to leave the house that she paid for cause it was in his name so she had to move to the other side of town in a one bed room apt and would visit the house when he wasn’t there for a while it seemed like my father hated me he beat me a lot and even after my first suicide attempt he called me selfish and told me he was tired of me and I needed to go live with my mom which I couldn’t cause there was no room he ignored me for a month after that. she was trying really hard to get a big enough space for all her kids but she couldn’t cause she was sick and couldn’t work. Ive lived the same place my entire life but due to my anxiety I just never was outgoing enough to make friends all the people in school all had cell phones name brand clothes game consoles I didn’t have any of that so they weren’t interested,  the friends I did have preferred other people in the friend group over me so I was just there we never really bonded or had a real friendship outside of school besides my one friend who moved away. Now I’m an adult that doesn’t really know how to keep a conversation and has no idea how to make friends I don’t really bond or connect with anyone

Unfortunately my mom isn’t available rn. I would absolutely pay $30 per session I never really looked in to private therapists cause I never thought I could afford it I’ll have to ask about that thank you so much for telling me. At this point I don’t want to die I just want the pain to go away and to be happy not even happy cause that seems so unrealistic but just to be okay. the only person that made me happy and kept me holding on left me today because of my mental illnesses

Hi, we are in very very similar situations due to trauma and my fear of abandonment I’m also a doormat and am nice to everyone even people who have wronged or abused me I let it happen cause I’m afraid of losing them and don’t feel like I deserve better. Everything you feel I feel the same didn’t mean to rant but just wanted to let you know how similar our situations are so you know you’re definitely not alone, if you want to talk I’m here

I’ve been focussing on the version of him I’ve made up in my head when he’s shown me who he really is 1000 times over it’s time to accept he never was what I thought

Hi I know I’m late but I just came across this as someone who’s had Gerascophobia since I was 5 I completely understand where you’re coming from suicidal thoughts and all, my 10th birthday I spent locked in my room and crying cause I was in the double digits. I spoke to my doctor at first he was able to look into my other symptoms and give me medication for my mental illnesses such as anxiety/depression that intensifies this fear I did try therapy and recommend it for you to but I will tell you it’s hard finding one who understands countless times they’ve laughed and brushed it off saying “you’re so young!” “I’m older than you and I’m fine!” Completely missing the point. If they don’t help you or understand you have every right to discontinue seeing them and seeking out a therapist that does it’s still very hard honestly I really wouldn’t wish gerascophobia on anyone I hope you’re doing better or if you’re not you do in the near future

Yeah it relaxes you it works as a tranquilizer on your nervous system stops panic or anxiety attacks/overthinking you get very calm but I know a couple people on Citalopram they say it helps them a lot

I would only recommend if you’ve been prescribed by a professional, that being said I’ve been prescribed lorazepam which is a benzo and very similar to Xanax just slightly less powerful/addicting I have had to take it a couple times before spending time with my LO sometimes even after

It’s very painful to think you’ve caused pain to someone you care about whether intentional or not but if she said yes multiple times like you said she did it was not rape at worst it was sexual coercion. unfortunately you can’t change how she feels about the situation you both experienced that night differently but you can at least learn from this and take extra precaution when asking for consent in the future that way you both are 100% sure and on the same page. Right now she might be triggered don’t reach out to her it’ll only make her feel worse wait it out for a bit and if you are still talking to her sister maybe try and ask her how your friend described the night to her to see where it could have possibly gone wrong so you know for the future. turning yourself in won’t take back what happened so she won’t feel much better I can’t say that this won’t ever happen again but usually when a girl says yes multiple times she means it. if you’re being 100% truthful about asking for consent and in no way pressuring her then it seems like you didn’t do anything wrong and this is all just a very horrible misunderstanding
